item.title: PSLM 0.1.5
item.description:
PSLM 0.1.5

Beta build. This one changes how the High tier sounds.

High now masters to about −9 LUFS instead of −8.5. −9 is the level PSLM was tuned to by ear; −8.5 had slipped in by accident and was pushing harder than the material usually takes. Expect High to come out very slightly quieter and a little cleaner up top. Low, Mid and Smart are unchanged, and nothing else in the engine changed.

This is still a time-limited beta: mastering and export stop on 22 October 2026. The app still opens after that and nothing you have made is affected.

  • The in-app FAQ was wrong about two things: it said High targets −9.5, which no build has ever done, and it listed exports as “WAV and MP3 320 today” when FLAC and AAC have shipped for a while. Both corrected.
  • Third-party licence notice and the About line now read “The JC Guthrie Group LLC”.

item.title: PSLM 0.1.4
item.description:
PSLM 0.1.4

Beta build. No change to the mastering sound — the engine is untouched.

This is a time-limited beta: mastering and export stop on 22 October 2026. The app still opens after that and nothing you have made is affected.

  • Export now tells you when it cannot work — MP3 and FLAC need encoders that are not on every Mac, so PSLM checks up front and names what is missing instead of blaming the output folder. Deliverables that fail are reported, not silently skipped.
  • Tools › Master Check works again; it was greyed out even after a successful master.
  • Send feedback, and report a crash. PSLM sends nothing on its own — it opens an email you read and send yourself, and your audio is never included.
  • Check for Updates is now a button in Settings. Dialogs restyled to match the app; Settings shows the correct version.

item.title: PSLM 0.1.3
item.description:
PSLM 0.1.3

Maintenance release. No change to the mastering sound, the engine, or any feature.

  • Corrected the bundled third-party license notices — full license texts for KissFFT, sys/queue.h and Sparkle, and a proper LGPL written offer for LAME.

item.title: PSLM 0.1.2
item.description:
PSLM 0.1.2

  • Auto de-harsh — when a loud master introduces harsh vocal highs, PSLM now measures it and gently tames them automatically. Clean/bright masters are left untouched.
  • Cleaner in-app A/B monitoring — the compare plays at the file's native sample rate, so what you hear matches the exported file.
  • Master Check quality pass refinements.

item.title: PSLM 0.1.1
item.description:
PSLM 0.1.1

  • Lower peak memory in the full mastering chain — more headroom on long / heavy tracks.
  • Audio-thread safety guard in the A/B preview.
  • Internal fixes. No change to the mastering sound.
